source: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (natural=coastline, natural=strait via Overpass), tools/build-passes.mjs
note: Each pass is a carve polygon (lon/lat rings, even-odd) = the real water of the channel from OSM plus a tube at the boat's minimum width, tuned so the game's collision (shore.js isBlocked, hull 2.5 game m) lets a boat through end to end. Apply with src/passes.js applyPasses(world, passes). tier: ship = the recommended first batch (light carves, at most 2x the real width); later = light carves worth doing after; eye = widened more than 2x, or a real channel under 20 m, or not navigable: NOT shipped, needs Felix's eye (see eyeReason). harbour = a harbour approach (tier added 2026-11-06): carved WITH the ship tier (applyPasses tiers [ship, harbour]), may be widened more than x1.7 but keeps the real shape and the quay (OSM quay / breakwater lines stay land); see harbour-audit.json.
